overall_assessment: Section boundaries generally work across all 20 reviewed courses: all learning-outcome groups survive, assessment design tables are retained correctly, and empty prerequisites/reading-list placeholders and trailing metadata are excluded. Most pre-pass flags are false alarms: the practicum labels Arbeidsmåter og vurderingsformer and Læremidler name course topics; repeated assessment designs and notices that arbeidskrav exist are substantive despite their boilerplate flags. Local semantic misclassification remains, the PUB3000 cross-section duplicate is real, and three of the six random controls expose administrative or assessment-logistics contamination, so these residual issues are not confined to flagged courses.

findings.evidence: kompetanse i å kunne ta stilling til hensiktsmessige arbeidsformer i møte med konkrete problemstillinger i egen/fremtidig arbeidshverdag
findings.description: In both SOSP3002 offerings, course_content consists of a lead and statements of knowledge, skills and competence students will acquire. These are learning outcomes by the codebook, so the leak->learning_outcomes flags identify a real semantic problem, although no structural heading was merged. The inverse occurs in random control DOKHIS: learning_outcomes starts with a paragraph describing the subject and historical perspectives, before its actual outcome lead and groups. Three of 20 courses show this content/outcomes boundary error.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: sectionize() follows correctly read institutional headings, but those source fields mix meanings. R/extract_sections.R has no INN sentence moves for outcomes under course_content, and .split_lo_intro() currently handles subject-description introductions only for phs.
findings.suggested_fix: Extend .split_lo_intro() to INN for the descriptive paragraph before the actual outcome lead, preserving that lead and all three outcome groups. Add an INN block move for course_content beginning Det andre emnet i videreutdanningen vil gi studentene: followed by the kunnskap/ferdigheter/kompetanse list, appending that block once to learning_outcomes and dropping the empty content row.

findings.evidence: Emnet er bygd opp av to temaer.
findings.description: The complete 2,093-character course_content body is also emitted as teaching_methods. It mainly describes the two subject themes and their theories, so copying the whole block into teaching_methods both duplicates text across canonical sections and misrepresents topics as teaching arrangements. This dup_in_course flag is real. The repeated Kunnskap/Ferdigheter outcomes visible in the full plan are a separate source repetition and are not evidence that the extractor duplicated those outcomes.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The heading list maps both source fields as expected; the duplicate may already be in the source teaching field rather than arising from a selector error. sectionize() and .list_to_sections() merge/deduplicate within each section but do not detect identical bodies across different sections. The capped full-plan excerpt does not establish which source mechanism produced the second copy.
findings.suggested_fix: Add an INN guard for a teaching_methods body identical after whitespace normalization to course_content and beginning Emnet er bygd opp av to temaer. Suppress that redundant teaching row and flag the source-field duplication for correction; retain the original full plan as provenance. Avoid globally removing short phrases shared by otherwise different sections.

findings.description: Both SOSP3002 teaching_methods rows retain the explicit requirement that arbeidskrav involve trying out the social-pedagogue role, while coursework_requirements lists only the written work, presentations and attendance. Their leak->coursework_requirements flags therefore expose a genuine requirement sentence, not an uncut heading; the neighboring learning-arena context does not all need moving. In random control AUD3003, teaching_methods likewise contains the requirement to contribute at least ten working days to fellow students’ projects, whose documentation must be approved before the exam in coursework_requirements. These concrete mandatory activities belong with coursework requirements.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The inline coursework splitter in R/extract_sections.R processes teaching_methods, but its gate and attendance patterns do not recognize Arbeidskravene fordrer ... or the AUD wording studentene skal arbeide minst to uker ... as coursework gates. Source-heading assignment therefore leaves part of each requirement behind.
findings.suggested_fix: Add narrow INN sentence moves from teaching_methods to coursework_requirements for ^Arbeidskravene fordrer and the AUD sentence containing studentene skal arbeide minst to uker and som medvirkende. Append these once alongside the existing requirements; preserve the surrounding descriptions of teaching and collaboration.

findings.evidence: Emneansvarlig lærer har ansvar for at studentene involveres i evaluering av undervisningen i tråd med høgskolens kvalitetssystem.
findings.description: Three random controls retain plan text that belongs to none of the seven sections: DOKHIS course_content includes the admission-only sentence Opptakskravet er generell studiekompetanse/realkompetanse.; MUSB2900 teaching_methods includes the course-evaluation responsibility sentence quoted here; AUD3003 teaching_methods includes the Økonomi label and the school’s project-funding notice. These are not substantive topics or teaching methods. AUD’s separate budget/plan approval requirement should be preserved as a requirement rather than deleted with the funding notice.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The source embeds these sentences inside otherwise valid section bodies, without separately read exclusion headings. R/extract_sections.R has no INN sentence cleanup for them; admission cleanup is applied to prerequisites, and .evaluation_part_regex relies on an explicit Emneevaluering label that MUSB2900 lacks.
findings.suggested_fix: Add precise INN cleanup rules in .clean_sections() or .sentence_moves: drop the standalone general-admission sentence from course_content, remove the quoted course-evaluation responsibility sentence from teaching_methods, and remove the standalone Økonomi label plus Skolen bidrar med en fast sum prosjektmidler for hver student. Move the following sentence requiring an approved budget and progress plan to coursework_requirements, retaining its wording.

findings.evidence: Sensureres av faglærer og én ekstern sensor.
findings.description: Two random controls contain assessment logistics excluded by course_plan_spec.md: AUD3003 retains the examiner arrangement quoted here; MUSB2900 retains both Eksamensresultatet kan påklages. and Eksamensresultatet kan ikke påklages. These procedural sentences should stay only in the full plan. The adjacent assessment forms, practical submission alternatives, weights, grading scales, duration and permitted aids are valid assessment design, including their table headers, and should remain.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/extract_sections.R strips mapped sensorordning headings and selected inline logistics, but .section_noise has no INN patterns for these inline examiner and appeal sentences. They share paragraphs or lines with valid assessment design, so heading boundaries cannot remove them.
findings.suggested_fix: Add sentence-level INN assessment cleanup matching ^Sensureres av faglærer og én ekstern sensor and ^Eksamensresultatet kan (?:ikke )?påklages. Remove only those sentences with .strip_sentences(), preserving the product/concert alternatives and all other assessment design on the same lines.
